data.desc: Algorhythm Holdings, Inc. is a holding Company, with two primary assets, Azure Energy and SemiCab Holdings. Azure Energy provides strategic and technical advisory for renewable biomass power generation infrastructure. For additional information, please go to: http://www.azure-energy.co. Algorhythm Holdings, Inc. also owns and operates SemiCab, an AI-enabled logistics software provider. Since 2020, SemiCab has enabled major retailers, brands and transportation providers to address common supply-chain problems globally. With SemiCab's AI platform, shippers pay less and carriers make more without having to change a thing.
